protocolAmendmentsBeforeFreeze.reason: The bulk-only prototype omitted the published PWP gradient-shear closure and over-deepened strong-storm wakes.
protocolAmendmentsBeforeFreeze.decision: Fix the gradient Richardson threshold at the published PWP value 0.25; it is not tunable.

protocolAmendmentsBeforeFreeze.reason: Contract v1's 3-7 inertial-period range excluded the published PWP decay ucon=0.1|f|, equivalent to about 1.6 inertial periods.
protocolAmendmentsBeforeFreeze.decision: Correct the admissible range to 1-5 inertial periods and retain 1.6 as the literature anchor.

protocolAmendmentsBeforeFreeze.reason: JTWC best-track wind is a one-minute maximum while the ocean stress forcing represents a ten-minute open-ocean mean.
protocolAmendmentsBeforeFreeze.decision: Apply the fixed WMO open-ocean 0.93 conversion factor at the forcing boundary; it is not tunable.

validationHistoryBeforeFreeze.handling: Logged as an exploratory protocol breach. Subsequent parameter selection used development metrics and published physical constraints only. The four-storm validation cohort is treated as seen and cannot support an HF-6 independent confirmatory claim.

selectionRule: No parameter or fixed closure may change after this manifest in response to acceptance-partition results. Any such change requires a new sealed cohort and contract version.
